title: NearMod
description: A mod that allows you to open a menu that shows the player next to you at a distance of 100 blocks. The mod even works on servers.
body:
A mod that allows you to open a menu that shows the player next to you at a distance of 100 blocks. The mod even works on servers.
You can change the menu opening button in Minecraft's control settings.
![Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8326cca30dbcfc8bd55bce59a398f7dfd6f9338a.png)
